name: Draft the monthly investor update
when: The founder wants the monthly update for investors and advisors, or a board task asks for "the <month> update".
procedure: Call gather_month with since set to the first day of the month being reported. It returns dated lines, each naming the card it came from.
Write a doc with create_doc, titled "<Month> update", in five parts: Highlights, Numbers, What shipped, Asks, Lowlights.
Numbers: the north star first, then the rest, each with its change and the card in brackets, e.g. "MRR $3,120, up 8% [Metrics]". Then runway months left [Runway].
What shipped: decisions decided and board tasks done, one line each. Highlights and lowlights come only from these lines.
Asks: copy the founder's own asks if they wrote any; otherwise leave "Asks: (founder to add)".
End with a line naming any card gather_month said is not wired, so the founder knows what is missing.
pitfalls: Never invent traction: every number must appear in gather_month's lines, with the card it came from. A number you cannot cite is left out.
Do not round a change into a trend, or call a flat month growth.
Do not send it. The founder edits and sends it from the mail card.
verify: Every number in the doc appears in gather_month's lines with its card named beside it, the five parts are there, and nothing was sent.
